purpose: An endless, generated rally stage seen from above in low-poly 3D, with the time on top. The car drives itself and the road never repeats. It is ambient art you glance at, not a game: no controls, no lap times.

night.recipe: The kiosk's night palette forces the night scene (moonlight, headlights, tail lights); the mat behind the canvas is --face-bg and the time keeps a non-inverting ink because it sits on the scene, falling back to --face-ink on the bare mat.

options.intent: Auto drives through every world, a new one every ten minutes; pick one to stay there.
Auto rolls a new sky every 30 seconds from what the world allows, so the dunes never get rain.
Real follows the time of day; night mode always wins and drives at night.
Auto picks a car that suits the world and changes it every minute.
Cruising speed on straights in km/h; the car always brakes for bends, and mountains run slower.
24-hour by default; off drops the leading zero and counts 1 to 12.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not let the render loop run while the face is not shown
antiPatterns.why: a kiosk runs for weeks and a hidden 3D scene is pure heat on a Pi

antiPatterns.rule: Do not render every frame at 60 fps
antiPatterns.why: a stage seen from 50 m up reads the same at 30, at half the GPU load

antiPatterns.rule: Do not load three.js from the main bundle
antiPatterns.why: every other face would pay for it; it ships as a chunk imported when this face mounts

specless: A 3D scene with digital time; there is no hand geometry to describe.
